frame0_iss_recognition.notes: Immediate, unmistakable recognition of the full International Space Station from an elevated three-quarter vantage point (x=52..990, y=740..1128 at 1080x1920): central cylindrical pressurized modules, full integrated truss backbone, white thermal radiators, and all 8 copper-brown solar array wings clearly separated.

faithful_intact_geometry.notes: All 44 materials and 114 embedded textures of the official NASA/JSC/IGOAL GLB render intact with zero clipped solar array tips (~52 px left margin, ~90 px right margin at frame 30), zero severed spacecraft, and zero invented/flat-icon geometry.

phone_preview_clarity_270x480.notes: At 270x480, the station spans y=185..282 over the darker blue Indian Ocean band between cloud decks. In moving playback, 3D orbital parallax between the rotating foreground station and drifting cloud/ocean backdrop cleanly separates habitable modules, truss, radiators, and all 8 solar array wings from the Earth background.

native_motion_and_parallax.notes: Genuine 30/1 fps 3D perspective camera orbit (angle 0.900 -> 1.085 rad, y 14.000 -> 12.822 at radius 35) with clear depth parallax between foreground solar wings/modules, far truss, and Earth backdrop; frame0_diff_0_1_5s = 7.57% (>= 1.50%).

coherent_earth_fill.notes: 100% portrait coverage (0 unfilled grid samples across all 102 frames) using a single continuous 3D backdrop plane with NASA Blue Marble composite GSFC_20171208_Archive_e002130; zero reflected smudge bands, zero duplicate silhouettes, zero black bars or seams.

crop_scale_and_sharpness.notes: Native 1.0x 1080x1920 WebGL station render; Earth backdrop max local enlargement 1.1975x (<= 2.35x cap). no_freeze_jitter_or_transition.notes: Monotonic per-frame parametric motion at 30/1 fps; zero repeated/dropped frames, zero phase-correlation jitter (polish_gate PASS), and zero mid-clip cuts.
